author: iCleanUp
body:
Hello my name is Trevor wells, i am the owner of the account iCleanUp, around a year ago i was playing on this server and i had just found out about how to use "hacked clients" and i was using kill aura on your server, i was banned  bc the SR Moderator Fouled for hacking [Kill aura] on Ocotbober 1, 2015 10:28:17 PM GMT, i would like to hopefully be able to have this problem resolved and have my ban removed, i always really enjoyed playing your server and really wish i could come back, i promise to never EVER EVER use hacked clients or any modifications that would give me an advantage, if you could remove the ban i would mean the world to me

~Your freind iCleanUp
